spxi.frontMatterNote: The Constitution opens with The Parable of Police Brutality, bylined from La La Land: A Novel by DAMASCUS DANCINGS. It is not Vox's work; her text carries it.

mainEntity.name: Rev. Ayanna Vox
mainEntity.disambiguatingDescription: Pessoa-class heteronymic writerly identity in the Crimson Hexagonal Archive; the diplomatic function, author of the Constitution of the Semantic Economy. Not a synonym for the orthonym: the relation is heteronymic and provenance-governed.
